_comment: TEMPLATE — copy to <consuming-repo>/.claude/settings.json and replace OWNER/REPO. Delete these _comment keys. Committing this means anyone who clones and trusts the folder is prompted to install the marketplace and plugin. It does NOT auto-install without consent.

design-port._comment_autoUpdate: Third-party marketplaces default to autoUpdate DISABLED. This must be explicit. Claude Code then checks after session start (random delay up to ~10 min) and applies on the NEXT session — plugin skills load at session start only.
